content.text:
**Finding: compliant (preferred).**

No non-compete or field-of-use restraint binds Northwind. §12.3 affirmatively confirms we may develop, acquire, licence, sell or use any product or service and operate in any field or territory, and that we have made no exclusivity or non-compete commitment — squarely the preferred position, so no redline is proposed.

Locations checked and cleared:
- §2 (scope) — no minimum commitment; declining further Order Forms is expressly not a breach.
- §12.4 — competing-products restraint binds **Vendor**, benefits us; not flagged.
- §13.1/13.4 — licence scope ("internal business purposes") and customary reverse-engineering/misuse restrictions; these are use-of-Service terms, not restraints on our business or products.
- §24, §26, §28, §30 — competitor reference in §24 limits Vendor's assignment (in our favour); no restrictive covenant elsewhere.
